document.about: UN DESA World Economic Situation and Prospects 2025 (212 pages). Its annex pages end on a running label, and a box ends on its author's byline.

notes: 2026-11-28: guard. A label or a byline at a page's foot, its line far short of the measure, is no line a page break cut.

checks.issue: `ANNEX TABLES` must not run on into the next page's table label.
A box's byline must not run on into the next page's text.
